description: Operate remote SSH servers through the bundled CLI and YAML server configurations. Use for remote commands, service restarts, log inspection, file transfer, text edits, deployments, background jobs, and aliases on bash/cmd/powershell servers, even when the user does not explicitly mention SSH. Local-only builds and GitHub releases without a remote server operation are outside this skill's scope. Trigger keywords: deploy, release, ship, server health, SSH, run on server, upload script, download file, server alias, 部署, 上线, 发布, 重启, 查看日志, 服务器健康检查.
